_readme: Optional file: copy this to <config dir>/systems.json to add systems or
retune the built-in ones.  <config dir> is /mnt/mmc/Roms/APPS/Retrostation
on the device, or ~/.retrostation on a desktop.
The built-in table is never replaced.  Each entry either ADDS a system the
table lacks, or sets individual fields on one it has -- so changing one
core here still leaves every other system on its built-in value.
key          matches the ROM directory name (case-insensitive)
label        English name            label_zh    Chinese name
extensions   file suffixes, no dot   core        RetroArch core file name
alt_cores    fallback cores          standalone  launcher command, {rom} substituted
hidden       true to hide a built-in system entirely (it is not scanned either)
A malformed entry is skipped with a log line; the frontend always starts.

systems._note: ADD: a directory the built-in table has never heard of.
systems.label: Handheld

systems._note: REPLACE ONE FIELD: GBA keeps its name and art, only the core changes.
HIDE: Virtual Boy stays in the table but is never scanned or shown.
